metadata.name: Chandrayaan-2 OHRC vs LROC NAC
metadata.description: High-resolution optical lunar surface with severe shadow inversion caused by 105 degree difference in solar illumination azimuth.

ohrc.quality_report_text:
=======================================================
   LUNAMATCH - CHANDRAYAAN-2 REGISTRATION QUALITY REPORT
   Sensor Modality: OHRC
=======================================================
Total candidate matches : 160
RANSAC inliers          : 27
Inlier ratio             : 16.88%
RMSE                     : 1.5225 pixels
Mean matching error      : 1.4103 pixels
Coverage                 : 29.69%
Sub-pixel accuracy (<0.5): 7.41%
Spatial Uniformity Score : 0.689 / 1.000
Registration Quality     : Good (Valid Geometric Match)
=======================================================

stage_logs.name: Image Preprocessing
stage_logs.detail: Source dimensions: 600x600 (OHRC), Reference: 600x600. Denoising & radiometric normalization.

stage_logs.name: Illumination & Sun-Angle Compensation
stage_logs.detail: Constructing gradient magnitude and topographic ridge invariant representations (Src Az: 45.0°, Ref Az: 150.0°).

stage_logs.name: Multi-Scale Pyramid Representation
stage_logs.detail: Building 3-level Gaussian & Laplacian multi-resolution image pyramids (1x, 0.5x, 0.25x).

stage_logs.name: Sensor-Invariant Feature Extraction
stage_logs.detail: Detecting scale-space extrema & mapping descriptors to RootSIFT Hellinger kernel space.

stage_logs.name: Feature Correspondence & Mutual Verification
stage_logs.detail: Extracted 6605 source and 5711 reference keypoints. Applying Lowe's ratio test and bilateral cross-check.

stage_logs.name: Geometric Verification (RANSAC)
stage_logs.detail: Estimating HOMOGRAPHY transformation across 160 candidate correspondences with reprojection threshold 2.5 px.

stage_logs.name: Sub-Pixel Refinement
stage_logs.detail: Refining 30 inlier correspondences to fractional pixel precision using local patch NCC quadratic peak estimation and least-squares model fine-tuning.

stage_logs.name: Uniform Spatial Distribution
stage_logs.detail: Binning into 8x8 grid to eliminate crater clustering and maximize lunar surface coverage.

stage_logs.name: Registration & Visual Outputs
stage_logs.detail: Generating warped registered image, 50/50 blend, checkerboard overlay, and residual difference map.

stage_logs.name: Evaluation Metrics & Quality Report
stage_logs.detail: Computing RMSE, inlier ratio, spatial coverage, and sub-pixel accuracy scores.
